title: DSG Spacetime
description: DSG Spacetime is a customer-hosted governed AI-agent system that separates reasoning and workflow orchestration from execution authority. It combines AI planning, Automation Spacetime for workflow coordination, Core Spin for stateful continuation, Governance Spacetime for exact-action authorization, node-to-node capabilities, governed execution, and verifiable evidence/proof while allowing customer systems to remain in their own infrastructure. Version 1.2.0 adds a dated 2026-10-30 public empirical evidence package: research publication provenance, an exact-image NVIDIA Nemotron API read-only Workroom/browser/Memory result, signature-verification scope, a machine-readable evidence manifest, and a public reproduction protocol. Production source ea73ac8d9aeada37c2cfeec158ff0dcda573d589 and OCI digest sha256:94115f03476e93a8dbce43cbdcf37951c4a148d3c998ae87683c7185cd7a8f10 identify the scoped acceptance. Primary execution records and the internally verified Ed25519 CI attestation remain access-restricted. Public independent E2E reproduction, arbitrary desktop mutation, Kaggle Qwen3-30B GPU acceptance, and automatic worker recovery are not established. The archive contains public-safe documentation, not the private production implementation.
